---
title: "xucont"
---

## Description

Executes contents procedure.

## Parameters

**`inds`**

: Name(s) of the input dataset(s)

  *Required:* Yes

**`sourcelib`**

: Name of the input library

  *Required:* Yes

**`contopts`**

: Options for the contents procedure

  *Required:* No

  *Default:* `varnum`

## Examples

```sas
%xucont(dmsuppdm,sdtm);
%xucont(adsl,adam);
```
